result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers use the real toggle names, put the masters and quiet hours first, and treat quiet hours as a time-picker schedule. A has internal errors: it calls the channel section '2 rows' but lists three items, and it says 'five groups' when there are four. A also mixes marketing items with plant-of-the-week and new plant suggestions under 'Discover and news'. B separates marketing more clearly, gives a sound reason for frost being on by default, and gives a concrete plan to start with section headers on one screen and split into subscreens only if needed. B's placement of new plant suggestions under Garden care is debatable. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers place all 14 toggles in sensible sections, put the masters and quiet hours at the top, and use defaults to separate care alerts from marketing. A is more internally consistent and better explains why quiet hours belongs with the channels. B has counting slips: its '2 rows' heading lists three items, and it claims 'five groups' when there are four. B does make a good case for putting new plant suggestions under Discover and adds useful build details like sticky section headers and collapsing the Discover and news section by default.
